summary: 𝖴 is generated floor by floor by Heisenberg elements ν(v, β); these depend continuously on (v, β), and rational parameters are dense.

steps.claim: T'.splitGram is hermitian and invertible: it is the image of the hermitian invertible T.splitGram under the ring homomorphism E → 𝔸_f, which commutes with the involutions.
steps.lean:
e))).topologicalClosure := have : IsHermUnit T'.splitGram := e ▸ ⟨Matrix.IsHermitian.map
    IsHermUnit.conjTranspose_eq _ fun _ ↦ by simp, IsHermUnit.isUnit.map (RingHom.mapMatrix _)⟩

steps.claim: 𝖴 = 𝒩_{<ϱ} (unipotentBelow_eq_besselU); prove by induction over the floors (unipotentBelow_induction) that every element of 𝒩_{<j} lies in the closure: 1 does, and for γ ∈ 𝒩_l and ν in the closure, γν is in the closure.
steps.lean:
(unipotentBelow_eq_besselU .refl).ge.trans (unipotentBelow_induction (C := fun _ x ↦
    x ∈ _) (by simp) (fun l x c _ i ↦ by
    obtain h | h := le_or_gt 𝔰.ϱ l; simpa [eq_one_of_mem_floorGroup_inf c (.inr h)]
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_heisenbergElem_of_mem (a := ⟨l, h⟩) c
    exact mul_mem (map_mem_closure ((U.isClosedEmbedding_mat IsHermUnit.isUnit).continuous_iff.2 (by
      simp [Function.comp_def, TraceOne.heisenbergElem, eichlerMap]; fun_prop))
      ((DenseRange.piMap fun _ ↦ denseRange_algebraMap_finAdele).prodMap ((show Function.Surjective
      skewPart from (⟨TraceOne.τ * ·.1, by simp [skewPart, ← add_mul]⟩)).denseRange.comp
      denseRange_algebraMap_finAdele (by fun_prop)) _) fun _ ⟨q, k⟩ ↦
      k ▸ ⟨_, unipotentBelow_le_besselU (heisenbergElem_mem_floorUnipotent _ (q.1, skewPart q.2)).2,
      by ext; simp [inclMatrix, U.map, TraceOne.heisenbergElem, eichlerMap, ← e, Matrix.vecMulVec,
      Matrix.vecMul, entrywise, apply_ite (algebraMap ..), apply_ite star,
      TraceOne.τ, -Fintype.sum_sum_type, -splitGram_eq_ite_oppositeIndex]⟩) i) _)

steps.claim: If l ≥ ϱ, then γ ∈ 𝒩_l is 1 (eq_one_of_mem_floorGroup_inf), so γν = ν is in the closure.
steps.lean: obtain h | h := le_or_gt 𝔰.ϱ l; simpa [eq_one_of_mem_floorGroup_inf c (.inr h)]

steps.claim: If l < ϱ, then γ = ν(p) is a Heisenberg element of floor l for a finite adelic parameter p = (v, β) (exists_eq_heisenbergElem_of_mem).

γν lies in the closure, which is a subgroup: ν does, and so does γ = ν(p), because p ↦ ν(p) is continuous into the matrices (U(J') → matrices is a closed embedding and the entries of the Eichler map are polynomial in p) and rational parameters, whose Heisenberg elements are rational points of 𝖴, are dense:
steps.lean:
exact mul_mem (map_mem_closure ((U.isClosedEmbedding_mat IsHermUnit.isUnit).continuous_iff.2 (by
      simp [Function.comp_def, TraceOne.heisenbergElem, eichlerMap]; fun_prop))
      ((DenseRange.piMap fun _ ↦ denseRange_algebraMap_finAdele).prodMap ((show Function.Surjective
      skewPart from (⟨TraceOne.τ * ·.1, by simp [skewPart, ← add_mul]⟩)).denseRange.comp
      denseRange_algebraMap_finAdele (by fun_prop)) _) fun _ ⟨q, k⟩ ↦
      k ▸ ⟨_, unipotentBelow_le_besselU (heisenbergElem_mem_floorUnipotent _ (q.1, skewPart q.2)).2,
      by ext; simp [inclMatrix, U.map, TraceOne.heisenbergElem, eichlerMap, ← e, Matrix.vecMulVec,
      Matrix.vecMul, entrywise, apply_ite (algebraMap ..), apply_ite star,
      TraceOne.τ, -Fintype.sum_sum_type, -splitGram_eq_ite_oppositeIndex]⟩) i) _)

steps.claim: the skew part x ↦ x − x̄ is onto the skew elements (a skew β is the skew part of τβ, as τ + τ̄ = 1);
steps.lean:
show Function.Surjective
      skewPart from (⟨TraceOne.τ * ·.1, by simp [skewPart, ← add_mul]⟩))

steps.claim: hence the parameters with entries in E (v rational, β the skew part of a rational element) are dense among the finite adelic parameters (E is dense in 𝔸_f; products and images of dense maps are dense), and for such a parameter ν(v, β) is the image of the rational Heisenberg element, which lies in 𝒩_l ⊆ 𝖴(E) (heisenbergElem_mem_floorUnipotent); the matrix identity is checked entrywise.
steps.lean:

      denseRange_algebraMap_finAdele (by fun_prop)) _) fun _ ⟨q, k⟩ ↦
      k ▸ ⟨_, unipotentBelow_le_besselU (heisenbergElem_mem_floorUnipotent _ (q.1, skewPart q.2)).2,
      by ext; simp [inclMatrix, U.map, TraceOne.heisenbergElem, eichlerMap, ← e, Matrix.vecMulVec,
      Matrix.vecMul, entrywise, apply_ite (algebraMap ..), apply_ite star,
